name: INE median rent of new leases (0014696)

measures.definition: Median monthly rent per m² of new lease contracts of family homes signed in the municipality over the last 12 months, times 50 m².
Median monthly rent per m² of new lease contracts of family homes signed in the municipality over the last 12 months, times 90 m².

rights.attribution: Source: Statistics Portugal (INE), median rent of new lease contracts (indicator 0014696), CC BY 4.0

vetted.notes: Official, from leases declared to the tax authority; INE publishes the indicator itself on dados.gov.pt under CC BY 4.0.

caveats: New leases only, every size of home: smaller homes rent for more per m², so 50 m² at the median rate is on the low side for a one-bedroom flat.
